title: अष्टादशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 18 · Draupadi's lament: Bhima and Arjuna

summary.en: Draupadi grieves to see Bhima toiling as a cook and fighting beasts for the king's amusement, and Arjuna, once the terror of his enemies, dressed as a woman with braided hair teaching girls to dance. Their sufferings, she says, wither her body.
summary.kn: ಭೀಮನು ಅಡುಗೆಯವನಾಗಿ ದುಡಿದು ರಾಜನ ವಿನೋದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮೃಗಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡುವುದನ್ನೂ, ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಭಯವಾಗಿದ್ದ ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಜಡೆ ಹೆಣೆದು ಸ್ತ್ರೀವೇಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಕನ್ಯೆಯರಿಗೆ ನೃತ್ಯ ಕಲಿಸುವುದನ್ನೂ ಕಂಡು ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ದುಃಖಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅವರ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳು ತನ್ನ ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಒಣಗಿಸುತ್ತಿವೆ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: द्रौपदी भीम को रसोइए के रूप में परिश्रम करते और राजा के मनोरंजन के लिए पशुओं से लड़ते, तथा कभी शत्रुओं के लिए आतंक रहे अर्जुन को चोटी गूँथे स्त्री-वेश में कन्याओं को नृत्य सिखाते देखकर शोक करती हैं। वे कहती हैं कि उनके कष्ट उनके शरीर को सुखा रहे हैं।
summary.te: భీముడు వంటవానిగా శ్రమిస్తూ రాజు వినోదం కోసం మృగాలతో పోరాడడం, ఒకప్పుడు శత్రువులకు భయంకరుడైన అర్జునుడు జడ అల్లుకొని స్త్రీవేషంలో కన్యలకు నాట్యం నేర్పడం చూసి ద్రౌపది దుఃఖిస్తుంది. వారి కష్టాలు తన శరీరాన్ని ఎండిపోయేలా చేస్తున్నాయని అంటుంది.
summary.ta: பீமன் சமையல்காரனாக உழைத்து மன்னனின் பொழுதுபோக்குக்காக விலங்குகளுடன் போரிடுவதையும், ஒருகாலத்தில் பகைவர்களுக்கு அச்சமாக இருந்த அர்ஜுனன் சடை பின்னிப் பெண் வேடத்தில் கன்னியருக்கு நடனம் கற்பிப்பதையும் கண்டு திரௌபதி வருந்துகிறாள். அவர்கள் துன்பங்கள் தன் உடலை உலர்த்துகின்றன என்கிறாள்.
summary.ml: അടുക്കളക്കാരനായി പണിയെടുക്കുന്നതും, രാജാവിന്റെ വിനോദത്തിന് മൃഗങ്ങളോട് പോരാടുന്നതും കാണുമ്പോൾ ദ്രൗപദിക്ക് ഭീമനെക്കുറിച്ച് സങ്കടമാകുന്നു. ശത്രുക്കളുടെ ഭീതിയായിരുന്ന അർജുനൻ, മുടി ജടയിട്ട് സ്ത്രീവേഷം കെട്ടി പെൺകുട്ടികളെ നൃത്തം പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നതും അവൾക്ക് വേദനയാകുന്നു. ഈ കഷ്ടപ്പാടുകൾ തന്റെ ശരീരത്തെ ഉണക്കിക്കളയുന്നുവെന്ന് അവൾ പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 4.18; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Dec  1 2011

verses.text: द्रौपद्युवाच

meaning.en: Draupadi said:

verses.text:
इदं तु मे महद्दुःखं यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि भारत ।
न मेऽभ्यसूया कर्तव्या दुःखादेतद्ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, I shall tell you another great sorrow of mine. Do not be angry with me; I say it out of grief.

verses.text:
शार्दूलैर्महिषैः सिंहैरागारे युध्यसे यदा ।
कैकेय्याः प्रेक्षमाणायास्तदा मे कश्मलो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: When you fight with tigers, buffalo and lions in the palace, while Kaikeyi watches, I am overcome with faintness.

verses.text:
प्रेक्षासमुत्थिता चापि कैकेयी ताः स्त्रियो वदेत् ।
प्रेक्ष्य मामनवद्याङ्गी कश्मलोपहतामिव ॥

meaning.en: Rising from the show, Kaikeyi says to the women, seeing me as though overwhelmed with faintness:

verses.text:
स्नेहात्संवासजान्मन्ये सूदमेषा शुचिस्मिता ।
योध्यमानं महावीर्यैरिमं समनुशोचति ॥

meaning.en: "I think, from affection born of living together, this pure-smiling woman grieves for the cook as he fights mighty beasts."

verses.text:
कल्याणरूपा सैरन्ध्री बल्लवश्चातिसुन्दरः ।
स्त्रीणां च चित्तं दुर्ज्ञेयं युक्तरूपौ च मे मतौ ॥

meaning.en: "The sairandhri is beautiful and Ballava very handsome; women's hearts are hard to know; the two seem a fitting pair to me."

verses.text:
सैरन्ध्री प्रियसंवासान्नित्यं करुणवेदिनी ।
अस्मिन्राजकुले चेमौ तुल्यकालनिवासिनौ ॥

meaning.en: "The sairandhri, kind from living with someone she loves, and these two have lived in this royal house for the same length of time."

verses.text:
इति ब्रुवाणा वाक्यानि सा मां नित्यमवेदयत् ।
क्रुध्यन्तीं मां च संप्रेक्ष्य समशङ्कत मां त्वयि ॥

meaning.en: Saying such things, she constantly reproaches me, and, seeing me angry, she suspects me with regard to you.

verses.text:
तस्यां तथा ब्रुवत्यां तु दुःखं मां महदाविशत् ।
शोके यौधिष्ठिरे मग्ना नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे ॥

meaning.en: When she speaks so, great grief enters me; sunk in the sorrow for Yudhishthira, I cannot bear to live.

verses.text:
यः सदेवान्मनुष्यांश्च सर्पांश्चैकरथोऽजयत् ।
सोऽयं राज्ञो विराटस्य कन्यानां नर्तको युवा ॥

meaning.en: The one who, from a single chariot, conquered gods, men and serpents, is now the young dancer of King Virata's maidens.

verses.text:
योऽतर्पयदमेयात्मा खाण्डवे जातवेदसम् ।
सोऽन्तःपुरगतः पार्थः कूपेऽग्निरिव संवृतः ॥

meaning.en: The one of immeasurable soul who sated Fire in Khandava, that Partha, lives in the women's quarters like a fire shut in a well.

verses.text:
यस्माद्भयममित्राणां सदैव पुरुषर्षभात् ।
स लोकपरिभूतेन वेषेणास्ते धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: The bull among men from whom enemies always feared harm, that Dhananjaya now lives in a garb that people scorn.

verses.text:
यस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषात्समकम्पन्त शत्रवः ।
स्त्रियो गीतस्वनं तस्य मुदिताः पर्युपासते ॥

meaning.en: The one at whose bowstring's twang enemies trembled now has women delightedly attending his song.

verses.text:
किरीटं सूर्यसंकाशं यस्य मूर्धनि शोभते ।
वेणीविकृतकेशान्तः सोऽयमद्य धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: He on whose head a sun-bright crown shone, with his hair now braided and altered: that is Dhananjaya today.

verses.text:
यस्मिन्नस्त्राणि दिव्यानि समस्तानि महात्मनि ।
आधारः सर्वविद्यानां स धारयति कुण्डले ॥

meaning.en: In whom all the divine weapons reside, the support of all knowledge: he now wears earrings.

verses.text:
यं स्म राजसहस्राणि तेजसाप्रतिमानि वै ।
समरे नातिवर्तन्ते वेलामिव महार्णवः ॥

meaning.en: The one whom thousands of kings of matchless might could not pass in battle, as the great ocean does not pass its shore.

verses.text:
सोऽयं राज्ञो विराटस्य कन्यानां नर्तको युवा ।
आस्ते वेषप्रतिच्छन्नः कन्यानां परिचारकः ॥

meaning.en: That same man is now the young dancer of King Virata's daughters, living in disguise as the maidens' attendant.

verses.text:
यस्य स्म रथघोषेण समकम्पत मेदिनी ।
सपर्वतवना भीम सहस्थावरजङ्गमा ॥

meaning.en: At the roar of whose chariot the earth shook, Bhima, with its mountains, forests and all things moving and unmoving.

verses.text:
यस्मिञ्जाते महाभागे कुन्त्याः शोको व्यनश्यत ।
स शोचयति मामद्य भीमसेन तवानुजः ॥

meaning.en: At whose birth Kunti's grief vanished, that very brother of yours, Bhimasena, brings me grief today.

verses.text:
भूषितं तमलंकारैः कुण्डलैः परिहाटकैः ।
कम्बुपाणिनमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा सीदति मे मनः ॥

meaning.en: When I see him come adorned with ornaments, with golden earrings and conch bracelets on his arms, my heart sinks.

verses.text:
तं वेणीकृतकेशान्तं भीमधन्वानमर्जुनम् ।
कन्यापरिवृतं दृष्ट्वा भीम सीदति मे मनः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Arjuna, wielder of the fearsome bow, with his hair braided and surrounded by girls, Bhima, my heart sinks.

verses.text:
यदा ह्येनं परिवृतं कन्याभिर्देवरूपिणम् ।
प्रभिन्नमिव मातङ्गं परिकीर्णं करेणुभिः ॥

meaning.en: When I see him, godlike, surrounded by the girls like a rutting elephant ringed by cow-elephants,

verses.text:
मत्स्यमर्थपतिं पार्थं विराटं समुपस्थितम् ।
पश्यामि तूर्यमध्यस्थं दिशो नश्यन्ति मे तदा ॥

meaning.en: and standing before Virata, the Matsya king and master of wealth, in the midst of the music, the directions vanish from my sight.

verses.text:
नूनमार्या न जानाति कृच्छ्रं प्राप्तं धनंजयम् ।
अजातशत्रुं कौरव्यं मग्नं दुर्द्यूतदेविनम् ॥

meaning.en: Surely Kunti does not know that Dhananjaya has come to such hardship, nor that Ajatashatru the Kaurava is sunk in his wicked dice.

verses.text:
तथा दृष्ट्वा यवीयांसं सहदेवं युधां पतिम् ।
गोषु गोवेषमायान्तं पाण्डुभूतास्मि भारत ॥

meaning.en: And seeing the youngest, Sahadeva, the leader of warriors, going among the cows in a cowherd's garb, I turn pale, Bharata.

verses.text:
सहदेवस्य वृत्तानि चिन्तयन्ती पुनः पुनः ।
न विन्दामि महाबाहो सहदेवस्य दुष्कृतम् ।
यस्मिन्नेवंविधं दुःखं प्राप्नुयात्सत्यविक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Thinking again and again of Sahadeva's conduct, mighty-armed one, I find no wrongdoing by him for which that truly valiant man should suffer such sorrow.

verses.text:
दूयामि भरतश्रेष्ठ दृष्ट्वा ते भ्रातरं प्रियम् ।
गोषु गोवृषसंकाशं मत्स्येनाभिनिवेशितम् ॥

meaning.en: I am pained, best of the Bharatas, to see your dear brother, like a bull among the cows, placed by the Matsya king among his herds.

verses.text:
संरब्धं रक्तनेपथ्यं गोपालानां पुरोगमम् ।
विराटमभिनन्दन्तमथ मे भवति ज्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Excited, in red clothes, going in front of the cowherds, praising Virata: seeing it, a fever seizes me.

verses.text:
सहदेवं हि मे वीरं नित्यमार्या प्रशंसति ।
महाभिजनसंपन्नो वृत्तवाञ्शीलवानिति ॥

meaning.en: Our lady Kunti always praises my hero Sahadeva as of great family, well-behaved and virtuous.

verses.text:
ह्रीनिषेधो मधुरवाग्धार्मिकश्च प्रियश्च मे ।
स तेऽरण्येषु बोद्धव्यो याज्ञसेनि क्षपास्वपि ॥

meaning.en: "Modest, sweet-spoken, righteous and dear to me: he should be looked after, daughter of Yajnasena, in the forests, even at night."

verses.text:
तं दृष्ट्वा व्यापृतं गोषु वत्सचर्मक्षपाशयम् ।
सहदेवं युधां श्रेष्ठं किं नु जीवामि पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that best of warriors, Sahadeva, busy among the cows, sleeping on a calfskin, how can I live, Pandava?

verses.text:
यस्त्रिभिर्नित्यसंपन्नो रूपेणास्त्रेण मेधया ।
सोऽश्वबन्धो विराटस्य पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: He who is always endowed with three things, beauty, skill with weapons and intelligence, is now Virata's horse-keeper: see how time turns.

verses.text:
अभ्यकीर्यन्त वृन्दानि दामग्रन्थिमुदीक्षताम् ।
विनयन्तं जवेनाश्वान्महाराजस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Herds of horses scatter around him as he watches for the rope-knot, training the horses with speed before the great king's eyes.

verses.text:
अपश्यमेनं श्रीमन्तं मत्स्यं भ्राजिष्णुमुत्तमम् ।
विराटमुपतिष्ठन्तं दर्शयन्तं च वाजिनः ॥

meaning.en: I have seen that handsome, shining man, the best of Pandavas, now serving the Matsya Virata and showing off his horses.

verses.text:
किं नु मां मन्यसे पार्थ सुखितेति परंतप ।
एवं दुःखशताविष्टा युधिष्ठिरनिमित्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Scorcher of foes, Partha, do you think I am happy? Thus I am beset by a hundred sorrows because of Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
अतः प्रतिविशिष्टानि दुःखान्यन्यानि भारत ।
वर्तन्ते मयि कौन्तेय वक्ष्यामि शृणु तान्यपि ॥

meaning.en: There are other sorrows still greater than these, Bharata, which weigh on me, son of Kunti; I shall tell them too; listen.

verses.text:
युष्मासु ध्रियमाणेषु दुःखानि विविधान्युत ।
शोषयन्ति शरीरं मे किं नु दुःखमतः परम् ॥

meaning.en: While you all are alive, these various sorrows dry up my body; what greater sorrow can there be than this?
